_comment: Real-landscape validation manifest (cosmo plan Phase 6 / §5b).
SKELETON written by tests/scripts/harvest_octopus.py -- hand-edit the
'description' and any narrative caveats; the numeric fields (bbox,
target_epsg, octopus_source, run_params) are complete as written.
The DEM is fetched KEYLESS (Copernicus GLO-30) into a temp workdir by
run_cosmo_validation.py, compared, then deleted. No large data is
ever committed.
description: Clapp et al. (2002) Yuma Wash 10Be basins, Sonoran Desert, Arizona (OCTOPUS S014). 21 small catchments (0.48-29.1 km2), 230-436 m, LOW relief (OCTOPUS ELEV_STD ~50 m), topographic shielding ~1.0. A deliberately LOW-RELIEF, LOW-ELEVATION contrast to the pilot Front Range dataset (dethier2014, 1242-3480 m, relief ~94 m) and to the steep San Gabriel dataset (dibiase2010), spanning the terrain and elevation axes for the parallel numerics investigation (production scaling is near-unity at these low elevations, so the high-elevation S_tot scaling effect is absent here). Several outlets carry grain-size/aliquot replicates at the same coordinates (same delineated basin, different measured concentration).

published_reference.citation: Clapp, E.M., Bierman, P.R., Caffee, M. (2002), Geomorphology 45(1-2), 89-104.
published_reference.calculator: OCTOPUS v2.3(4) recalculation with CAIRN (Mudd et al. 2016), default Stone/Lal 'St' scaling (EBE_* fields).

_comment: Regression targets harvested from OCTOPUS, NOT scraped or invented.
OCTOPUS recalculates with CAIRN = the algorithm lsdtt-cosmo-tool
implements, so a NEAR-CAIRN oracle (see residual_expectation).
octopus_source.cql_note: Filter with CQL_FILTER, not bbox: the OCTOPUS WFS 2.0.0 bbox parameter throws a ProjectionException.
octopus_source.scaling_scheme: St (Stone/Lal) -- EBE_MMKYR / EBE_GCMYR. OCTOPUS also stores EBEL/EBELNS (LSDn).

_comment: Agreement will NOT be exact. lsdtt3 differs from OCTOPUS's CAIRN in
muon scheme (BraucherBorchers vs Braucher), topographic shielding
(lsdtt3 ignores it by default), and atmosphere (ERA40 vs NCEP), plus
the high-elevation scaling fix this suite found. See the pilot
dethier2014_manifest calculator_differences block for the quantified
three-way breakdown.
residual_expectation.band: measured-then-frozen on the FIRST accepted network run; do NOT assert a tight zero-residual band.
residual_expectation.attribute_residual_to: muon-scheme + topographic-shielding + atmosphere + high-elevation scaling + DEM product (COP30 vs original) + delineation -- NOT bugs.

dem.dem_source_note: Keyless. lsdtt-fetch-raster retrieves+clips Copernicus GLO-30 from AWS Open Data (cop30_aws) or Microsoft Planetary Computer (planetary_computer) with NO API key.
dem.target_epsg_note: UTM zone from OCTOPUS PROJEPSGID=32611. The cosmo CLIs require a PROJECTED CRS, so the DEM is warped to UTM at fetch time.
dem.resolution_choice_note: COP30 (30 m) vs the DEM in the OCTOPUS/CAIRN recalculation is a DOCUMENTED, attributable validation difference, not a bug.

bounding_box._comment: Union of the 21 selected basins' OCTOPUS polygon bounds, padded 0.02 deg.

_comment: lsdtt-cosmo-tool run knobs. threshold_contributing_pixels lowered
from the 1000 default (= 0.9 km2 at 30 m) so sub-km2 basins
delineate near their true size; basins below this*cellsize^2 remain
unreliable (outlet snaps onto a larger channel) and are flagged in
the summary. To match OCTOPUS's atmosphere add 'atmosphere: NCEP'
(default ERA40).
